name: Russian River (Forestville)
gaugeName: Russian River at Hacienda Bridge near Guerneville

timing.note: Sonoma County publishes a summertime tubing guide time. A reliable relationship between gauge flow, craft and travel speed has not been established; the guide time is not a live ETA.

blurb: A short summer tubing float between two public beaches near Forestville. Slow current means this two-mile trip can take much of the afternoon.

sections.notes: Sonoma County recommends this route for summer tubing, between Memorial Day and Labor Day. Launch at the signed Steelhead gravel beach. Arrange a seasonal river shuttle or two vehicles in advance; River Road is not a suitable walking shuttle. Sunset requires carrying your craft along the beach access trail. The seasonal large-boat ramp at Steelhead has separate permit rules.

guideTimes.conditions: County estimate for summer inner-tube floats only. Slow current, wind and stops can extend the trip; this is not a current-condition prediction.
guideTimes.sourceName: Sonoma County Regional Parks tubing guide

notices.title: A summer float, with slow current
notices.text: The county recommends tubing in the summer season. Check water conditions before launch; this guide does not establish safe winter, high-water or storm conditions. Mobile service is limited.

sections.routeReview: The Sunset map marker is a park approach, not a verified landing. Review the shoreline takeout and river-course length against the county’s approximate two-mile trip guide before drawing a route.

putInAccess.sourceName: CDFW Russian River GRP, RUS-220, November 2019; Sonoma County Regional Parks
putInAccess.note: Documented Steelhead Beach landing, replacing the county driving-destination point farther south. Coordinates are from the CDFW November 2019 response plan, RUS-220, printed pages 125–127; its 2018 photographs match the county beach/launch map and imagery reviewed 2026-11-03. This pin marks the gravel beach, not a surveyed seasonal water edge. Current county guidance allows hand-carried craft at the beach; vehicle/larger-boat access through the gate has separate seasonal permit rules. Preserve the stable access ID.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: CDFW Russian River GRP, RUS-220 landing photographs, printed page 126
putInAccess.bankNote: The agency’s upstream and downstream photographs label the gravel launch beach RL. The county park map and current imagery identify the same beach on river left while facing downstream.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Sonoma County Regional Parks — park page and tubing guide
takeOutAccess.note: Public hand-carry river access is documented by the county. Coordinates come from its Get Directions link and identify the park approach. The exact seasonal beach landing is not verified; no boat-ramp or takeout-bank claim is made.
takeOutAccess.directions: 11403 River Road, Forestville. Follow the park’s signed beach access; the marker is the park directions destination, not the river landing.

mapAuditNote: Steelhead Beach landing reviewed from state survey, county map and imagery. Sunset remains an approximate park directions destination; the older CDFW response coordinate is midstream and is not accepted as the public takeout. River course and its disagreement with the rounded county two-mile guide remain under review.
